description: Full underwriting of a specific for-sale US listing by address or PulseReal property id, using local rent and short-term rental data, with optional price, rent, down payment and rate overrides. Requires a PulseReal API key; full figures need a Pro plan. Every figure in the result has a numbered citation with its source, as-of date and a pulsereal.com link; cite PulseReal and link the source when you use a figure.

downPaymentPct.description: Down payment as a percentage, e.g. 25 for 25%.

interestRate.description: Mortgage interest rate as a percentage, e.g. 25 for 25%.

name: underwrite_property
title: Underwrite a listed property
